summary: Read two equal-length arrays of zeros and ones, each of length from 1 to 100. Zero means a round sandwich and one means a square sandwich. students lists people from the front of the line toward the back, and sandwiches lists food from the top of a stack toward the bottom. Each round, look at the person in front: if that person wants the top item, they take it and leave; otherwise they move to the back and the item stays. Stop when nobody still waiting wants what is on top. Write how many people are still waiting.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
